llm_analysis.page_title: Farm AI - Smart Crop Advisory System
llm_analysis.summary: Farm AI is a free, AI-powered platform designed to assist Indian farmers with smart crop management. It provides real-time features like disease detection via photo upload, crop advisory based on soil data, live market price tracking, and voice-guided advice in local languages. The system aims to increase yield, profitability, and efficiency through accessible technology.
key_facts: Offers instant disease detection by analyzing photos of sick leaves and suggesting treatments
Provides real-time market prices for nearby Mandis (local markets) to maximize farmer profits
Offers crop advisory services based on real-time soil data for sowing, irrigation, and harvesting
Supports voice-guided farming advice in local languages (Hindi, Marathi, etc.)
Connects farmers with experts and other farmers for community support
Free registration and usage for all farmers
Available in English, Hindi, and Marathi
Dedicated to improving Indian agriculture through technology and innovation

llm_analysis.page_title: Farm AI - Smart Crop Advisory System Registration Page
llm_analysis.summary: This webpage is the registration portal for **FarmAI**, an AI-powered agricultural advisory system. Users are prompted to input personal details (name, mobile number) and location to receive tailored crop-related guidance. The interface supports multiple languages, including English, Hindi, and Marathi.
key_facts: Requires users to provide a full name and mobile number (Indian format: +91 followed by 10 digits)
Supports registration in English, Hindi, and Marathi
Offers AI-driven crop advisory services for farmers
Includes a login option for existing users
Location-based advisory likely integrated into the system

site_summary.executive_overview: FarmAI is a free, AI-driven platform dedicated to empowering Indian farmers with smart agricultural solutions. It leverages cutting-edge technology to provide real-time crop advisory services, including disease detection via photo upload, soil-based crop recommendations, live market price tracking, and voice-guided guidance in local languages. The platform emphasizes accessibility, digital inclusion, and community support to enhance yield, profitability, and efficiency in farming practices.
key_highlights: Free AI-powered platform for Indian farmers to improve crop management and profitability
Real-time crop disease detection via photo upload for early intervention
Soil-based crop advisory to optimize planting decisions
Live market price tracking to help farmers make informed selling decisions
Voice-guided farming advice available in local languages (Hindi, Marathi, etc.)
Mobile-based registration/login system supporting Indian mobile formats (+91 10-digit)
Multilingual interface (English, Hindi, Marathi) for broader accessibility
Community-focused support system to foster collaborative farming solutions
